# One scenario per line: name, fixture, work tree, folder, then commands separated by " ;; ".
# Each command is run with git to record <format>/expected/writes/<name>/ (regenerate-writes.sh) and with pyn by
# tests/git_writes.rs, which compares what is left on disk. "+" in an argument is a space. Special commands:
#   @write <path> <text>   writes the file (text with "+" for spaces and "\n" for a newline)
#   @resume                `git commit --no-edit --cleanup=strip` for git, `pyn commit` for pyn (finishes a merge)
# A name starting with "out-" also compares the standard output of the last command.
# fixture: main = the dirty scenario repository (worktree/, linked/); merge = the clean merge repository.
# tree: main or linked.
branch-create	main	main	.	branch topic
branch-create-start	main	main	.	branch topic HEAD~2
branch-create-tag-start	main	main	.	branch topic v1
branch-exists-refused	main	main	.	branch feature
branch-nested	main	main	.	branch topic/deep HEAD~1 ;; branch topic2/a/b HEAD~3
branch-nested-clash-refused	main	main	.	branch topic HEAD~1 ;; branch topic/deep
branch-delete-merged	main	main	.	branch topic HEAD~1 ;; branch -d topic
branch-delete-unmerged-refused	main	main	.	switch -c work ;; commit -m work ;; switch -f main ;; branch -d work
branch-delete-forced	main	main	.	switch -c work ;; commit -m work ;; switch -f main ;; branch -D work
branch-delete-checked-out-refused	main	main	.	branch -d main
branch-delete-linked-refused	main	main	.	branch -D feature
branch-delete-missing	main	main	.	branch -d nope
branch-rename-current	main	main	.	branch -m trunk
branch-rename-other	main	main	.	branch old HEAD~3 ;; branch -m old older
branch-rename-onto-existing-refused	main	main	.	branch -m feature
out-branch-list	main	main	.	branch
out-branch-list-v	main	main	.	branch -v
out-branch-list-pattern	main	main	.	branch --list f*
out-branch-show-current	main	main	.	branch --show-current
out-branch-list-detached	main	main	.	checkout --detach HEAD~1 ;; branch
out-branch-list-linked	main	linked	.	branch -v
switch-dirty-refused	main	main	.	branch old HEAD~3 ;; switch old
switch-dirty-forced	main	main	.	branch old HEAD~3 ;; switch -f old
switch-carries-local-changes	main	main	.	branch other HEAD~1 ;; switch other
switch-new-branch	main	main	.	switch -c topic
switch-new-branch-start	main	main	.	switch -c topic HEAD~1
switch-new-branch-start-refused	main	main	.	switch -c topic HEAD~3
switch-new-branch-start-forced	main	main	.	switch -f -c topic HEAD~3
switch-previous	main	main	.	branch other HEAD~1 ;; switch other ;; switch -
switch-to-current	main	main	.	switch main
switch-commit-refused	main	main	.	switch HEAD~1
switch-detach	main	main	.	switch --detach HEAD~1
switch-detach-forced	main	main	.	switch -f --detach HEAD~3
switch-missing	main	main	.	switch nope
switch-linked-branch-refused	main	main	.	switch feature
switch-in-linked	main	linked	.	switch -c wt-topic
switch-in-linked-main-refused	main	linked	.	switch main
switch-in-subdir	main	main	src	branch other HEAD~1 ;; switch other
checkout-branch	main	main	.	branch other HEAD~1 ;; checkout other
checkout-branch-refused	main	main	.	branch old HEAD~3 ;; checkout old
checkout-new-branch	main	main	.	checkout -b topic
checkout-new-branch-start	main	main	.	checkout -b topic HEAD~1
checkout-commit-detached	main	main	.	checkout HEAD~1
checkout-tag-detached	main	main	.	checkout light
checkout-previous	main	main	.	branch other HEAD~1 ;; checkout other ;; checkout -
checkout-forced	main	main	.	branch old HEAD~3 ;; checkout -f old
checkout-paths-from-index	main	main	.	checkout -- README.md data.bin
checkout-paths-from-index-folder	main	main	.	checkout -- src
checkout-path-without-dashes	main	main	.	checkout README.md
checkout-paths-from-commit	main	main	.	checkout HEAD~3 -- README.md src
checkout-paths-from-commit-new-file	main	main	.	checkout HEAD~2 -- docs
checkout-paths-from-branch	main	main	.	checkout feature -- feature.txt
checkout-unknown-path	main	main	.	checkout -- nope.txt
checkout-dot	main	main	.	checkout -- .
restore-worktree	main	main	.	restore README.md data.bin
restore-worktree-folder	main	main	.	restore src
restore-worktree-dot	main	main	.	restore .
restore-source	main	main	.	restore --source=HEAD~3 README.md
restore-source-folder-removes	main	main	.	restore --source=HEAD~3 --worktree .
restore-source-new-folder	main	main	.	restore --source HEAD~2 docs
restore-staged-and-worktree	main	main	.	restore --staged --worktree src/lib.rs staged.txt
restore-staged-and-worktree-source	main	main	.	restore --source=HEAD~3 --staged --worktree README.md
restore-mode	main	main	.	restore feature.txt
restore-symlink	main	main	.	restore --source=HEAD~3 link
restore-unknown-path	main	main	.	restore nope.txt
restore-in-subdir	main	main	src	restore lib.rs
restore-in-linked	main	linked	.	restore feature.txt wt-only.txt
tag-lightweight	main	main	.	tag t1
tag-lightweight-at	main	main	.	tag t1 HEAD~2
tag-lightweight-of-annotated	main	main	.	tag t1 v1
tag-annotated	main	main	.	tag -a -m annotated+tag t1
tag-annotated-implied	main	main	.	tag -m two+words t1 HEAD~1
tag-annotated-multi-paragraph	main	main	.	tag -a -m first -m second t1
tag-annotated-of-annotated	main	main	.	tag -a -m nested t2 v1
tag-annotated-no-message-refused	main	main	.	tag -a t1
tag-exists-refused	main	main	.	tag light
tag-force	main	main	.	tag -f light HEAD~1
tag-force-annotated	main	main	.	tag -f -a -m again v1 HEAD~2
tag-delete	main	main	.	tag -d light
tag-delete-annotated	main	main	.	tag -d v1
tag-delete-missing	main	main	.	tag -d nope
tag-delete-several	main	main	.	tag -d light v1
tag-invalid-name-refused	main	main	.	tag bad..name
tag-in-linked	main	linked	.	tag -a -m linked t1
out-tag-list	main	main	.	tag
out-tag-list-pattern	main	main	.	tag -l l*
out-tag-delete	main	main	.	tag -d light
tag-dash-name-refused	main	main	.	tag -- -x
merge-ff	merge	main	.	merge ff
merge-ff-no-ff	merge	main	.	merge --no-ff ff -m ff+as+merge
merge-ff-only	merge	main	.	merge --ff-only ff
merge-ff-only-refused	merge	main	.	merge --ff-only clean
merge-up-to-date	merge	main	.	merge old
merge-up-to-date-no-ff	merge	main	.	merge --no-ff old
merge-clean	merge	main	.	merge clean
merge-clean-message	merge	main	.	merge clean -m Merge+clean+side
merge-clean-no-commit	merge	main	.	merge --no-commit clean
merge-clean-no-commit-no-ff	merge	main	.	merge --no-commit --no-ff clean
merge-clean-no-commit-resume	merge	main	.	merge --no-commit clean ;; @resume
merge-clean-in-subdir	merge	main	dir	merge clean
merge-clean-on-other-branch	merge	main	.	switch -c work ;; merge clean
merge-clean-on-detached	merge	main	.	switch --detach ;; merge clean
merge-conflict	merge	main	.	merge conflict
merge-conflict-no-ff	merge	main	.	merge --no-ff conflict -m custom+message
merge-conflict-status	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; status
merge-conflict-resolved	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; @write a.txt resolved\nline\n ;; @write b.txt bee+resolved\n ;; add a.txt b.txt ;; @resume
merge-conflict-resolved-with-message	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; @write a.txt resolved\n ;; @write b.txt resolved\n ;; add a.txt b.txt ;; commit -m resolved+it
merge-conflict-commit-unresolved-refused	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; commit -m nope
merge-conflict-add-one-then-commit-refused	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; @write a.txt resolved\n ;; add a.txt ;; commit -m nope
merge-abort	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; merge --abort
merge-abort-keeps-unrelated-local-changes	merge	main	.	@write main-only.txt local+edit\n ;; merge conflict ;; merge --abort
merge-abort-after-partial-resolution	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; @write a.txt resolved\n ;; add a.txt ;; merge --abort
merge-abort-without-merge-refused	merge	main	.	merge --abort
merge-continue-without-merge-refused	merge	main	.	merge --continue
merge-twice-refused	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; merge clean
merge-switch-during-merge-refused	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; switch clean
merge-modify-delete	merge	main	.	merge moddel
merge-add-add	merge	main	.	merge addadd
merge-dirty-file-refused	merge	main	.	@write a.txt local+edit\n ;; merge clean
merge-dirty-unrelated-file-allowed	merge	main	.	@write dir/x.txt local+edit\n ;; merge clean
merge-staged-change-refused	merge	main	.	@write dir/x.txt staged\n ;; add dir/x.txt ;; merge clean
merge-untracked-in-the-way-refused	merge	main	.	@write clean-only.txt mine\n ;; merge clean
merge-unknown-refused	merge	main	.	merge nope
merge-tag	merge	main	.	tag at-clean clean ;; merge at-clean
merge-annotated-tag	merge	main	.	tag -a -m release at-clean clean ;; merge at-clean
merge-mode-and-symlink-changes	merge	main	.	merge clean ;; status
merge-then-switch-back	merge	main	.	merge clean ;; switch -c after ;; switch main
merge-in-unborn-branch	merge	main	.	switch -c work ;; merge ff
stash	main	main	.	stash
stash-push-message	main	main	.	stash push -m my+saved+work
stash-include-untracked	main	main	.	stash -u
stash-in-subdir	main	main	src	stash
stash-in-linked	main	linked	.	stash
stash-nothing-to-save	merge	main	.	stash
stash-nothing-to-save-untracked-only	merge	main	.	@write fresh.txt new\n ;; stash
stash-untracked-only	merge	main	.	@write fresh.txt new\n ;; stash -u
stash-pop	main	main	.	stash ;; stash pop
stash-apply	main	main	.	stash ;; stash apply
stash-pop-untracked	main	main	.	stash -u ;; stash pop
stash-pop-on-other-branch	main	main	.	stash ;; switch -c other HEAD~1 ;; stash pop
stash-pop-conflict	main	main	.	stash ;; @write README.md different\n ;; add README.md ;; commit -m other+readme ;; stash pop
stash-pop-dirty-refused	main	main	.	stash ;; @write README.md local\n ;; stash pop
stash-pop-untracked-in-the-way-refused	main	main	.	stash -u ;; @write new.txt mine\n ;; stash pop
stash-drop	main	main	.	stash ;; stash drop
stash-clear	main	main	.	stash ;; stash clear
out-stash-list	main	main	.	stash ;; @write README.md two\n ;; stash ;; stash list
stash-two-pop-older	main	main	.	stash ;; @write README.md two\n ;; stash ;; stash pop stash@{1}
stash-three-drop-middle	main	main	.	stash ;; @write README.md two\n ;; stash ;; @write README.md three\n ;; stash ;; stash drop stash@{1}
stash-pop-without-stash-refused	main	main	.	stash pop
stash-drop-unknown-refused	main	main	.	stash ;; stash drop stash@{3}
stash-during-merge-refused	merge	main	.	merge conflict ;; stash
stash-clean-after-stash	main	main	.	stash ;; status
